chunks.l2:
[tal-a35-v01] Now the union of all scriptures is told: here is the whole ancient practice.

[tal-a35-v10] If come from the east, that — this certainty — of former time; and not consciousness-serenity alone, the whole sequence of practice.

[tal-a35-v02] Having sought prasiddhi, that very certainty is called āgama; for conjunction and exclusion depend on prasiddhi.

[tal-a35-v03] In dependence-on-self of the two's manifestation-groups, what would be their course? Even direct perception is born of eye, self, lamp, object and the rest.

[tal-a35-v04] It requires prasiddhi at the root — thus-natured, wrapped all around: born, one alone, hungry — a child.

[tal-a35-v05] What should he do, what take, by what see, what approach? Indeed, even in a hundred-things-strewn place, whatever is his —

[tal-a35-v06] of one seeing, or even smelling, of one touching: consciousness is serene, taking that very principle at once — it bears conjunction and exclusion.

[tal-a35-v07] Well! Even the serene consciousness, whatever goes with specific meaning, it too is previously fashioned by vāsanā-shaped reflection.

[tal-a35-v08] Not born of direct-perception-inference-etc-outer-proof-serenity; dependent-on-vāsanā previously — this is mere intuition — not.

[tal-a35-v09] Not the desire for eating-mud of a man, a child's, arises; dependent-on-vāsanā previously — if reflection — she and vāsanā.
chunks.sanskrit: [and]-:C35 atha śrītantrāloke pañcatriṃśamāhnikam athocyate samastānāṃ śāstrāṇāmiha melanam / iha tāvatsama sto@yaṃ vyavahāraḥ purātanaḥ prasiddhimanusandhāya saiva cāgama ucyate / anvayavyatirekau hi prasiddherupajīvakau svāyattatve tayorvyaktipūge kiṃ syāttayorgatiḥ / pratyakṣamapi netrātmadīpārthādiviśeṣajam apekṣate tatra mūle prasiddhiṃ tāṃ tathātmikām / abhitaḥsaṃvṛte jāta ekākī kṣudhitaḥ śiśuḥ kiṃ karotu kimādattāṃ kena paśyatu kiṃ vrajet / nanu vastuśatākīrṇe sthāne@pyasya yadeva hi paśyato jighrato vāpi spṛśataḥ saṃprasīdati / cetastadevādāya drāk so@nvayavyatirekabhāk hanta cetaḥprasādo@pi yo@sāvarthaviśeṣagaḥ / so@pi prāgvāsanārūpavimarśaparikalpitaḥ na pratyakṣānumānādibāhyamānaprasādajaḥ / prāgvāsanopajīvyetat pratibhāmātrameva na na mṛdabhyavahārecchā puṃso bālasya jāyate / prāgvāsanopajīvī cedvimarśaḥ sā ca vāsanā prācyā cedāgatā seyaṃ prasiddhiḥ paurvakālikī / naca cetaḥprasattyaiva sarvo vyavahṛtikramaḥ

chunks.l2:
[tal-a35-v11] Root, prasiddhi — that is proof: 'everywhere indeed' let it be accepted; in seeking dependence-of-the-prior, she sometimes herself.

[tal-a35-v12] For in that one all-knowing-nature, without doubt it shone before; practice is nowhere entire in a proof.

[tal-a35-v13] Hence — by mere non-all-knowing-priority, this is not established; in many-all-knowing-priorities no proof there is at all.

[tal-a35-v14] Gleaming with a hundred certainties of pleasure-release-and-their-causes; of that reflection-nature — it: Bhairava, the Supreme Lord.

[tal-a35-v15] Then too, from part-part union — she, certainty, tradition, scripture, or, having resorted to, spread, should make worlds practice.

[tal-a35-v16] By that very childhood, all delighting in carrying practice, being, co-depend on the Śaiva indeed, the first āgama.

[tal-a35-v17] But the incomplete others: hence not shareholders of liberation-fruit, co-depend; as far as — but that far shareholders of that fruit.

[tal-a35-v18] Even at childhood's end, whatever to-eat — this food is set going: by that certainty alone, not from perception, not from inference, not from impossibility.

[tal-a35-v19] And not anywhere here, from fault-hope-doubt: cessation; and certainty, born-of-non-cognition: understanding, word-natured.

[tal-a35-v20] Of the mother, nature — which, in her, one doubts — not this, ever; by self-making alone, of the all-knower — for: the doubter.
chunks.sanskrit: [and]-mūlaṃ prasiddhistanmānaṃ sarvatraiveti gṛhyatām / pūrvapūrvopajīvitvamārgaṇe sā kvacitsvayam sarvajñarūpe hyekasminniḥśaṅkaṃ bhāsata purā / vyavahāro hi naikatra samastaḥ ko@pi mātari tenāsarvajñapūrvatvamātreṇaiṣā na siddhyati / bahusarvajñapūrvatve na mānaṃ cāsti kiṃcana bhogāpavargataddhetuprasiddhiśataśobhitaḥ / tadvimarśasvabhāvo@sau bhairavaḥ parameśvaraḥ tataścāṃśāṃśikāyogātsā prasiddhiḥ paramparām / śāstraṃ vāśritya vitatā lokānsaṃvyavahārayet tayaivāśaiśavātsarve vyavahāradharājuṣaḥ / santaḥ samupajīvanti śaivamevādyamāgamam apūrṇāstu pare tena na mokṣaphalabhāginaḥ / upajīvanti yāvattu tāvattatphalabhāginaḥ bālyāpāye@pi yadbhoktumannameṣa pravartate / tatprasiddhyaiva nādhyakṣānnānumānādasambhavāt naca kāpyatra doṣāśāśaṅkāyāśca nivṛttitaḥ / prasiddhiścāvigānotthā pratītiḥ śabdanātmikā mātuḥ svabhāvo yattasyāṃ śaṅkate naiṣa jātucit / svakṛtatvavaśādeva sarvavitsa hi śaṅkaraḥ

chunks.l2:
[tal-a35-v21] As long as Śiva-hood is not in him, that long the self-following — that very — her, this certainty — he does not doubt.

[tal-a35-v22] In another doubting, she would there much esteem; thus, in future-Śiva-hood — this, prasiddhi — esteem, surely.

[tal-a35-v23] One alone āgama — and this, by the Lord, the all-seer, shown, which on the path, in activity and in cessation, standing.

[tal-a35-v24] In dharma, artha, kāma, mokṣa, through complete-incomplete-and-other-differences, in various fruits: one means, the Śāmbhava āgama.

[tal-a35-v25] In that — from subject-variety — in variably-fruit-giving, even the varied-means-teaching brings no contradiction.

[tal-a35-v26] Worldly, Vedic, Sāṅkhya, Yoga and the rest, Pāñcarātra, Buddha-Arhat-logic-scriptures, category-sequence-texts.

[tal-a35-v27] Siddhānta-tantra-Śakti and the rest, all Brahman-born, because in the venerable Svacchanda and the rest taught through Sadyoja-and-other-differences.

[tal-a35-v28] As in one place even, in Veda and the rest, going-to-that-that-āśrama, another-saṃskāra — here too; so the liṅga-uddhāra and the rest.

[tal-a35-v29] And as there, in the earlier āśrama, not from the later āśrama fruit comes; so from Pāñcarātra and the rest, not Śiva-nature.

[tal-a35-v30] One alone āgama — then there, from the worldly-scripture, from the beginning — from Vaiṣṇava, from Buddhist, from Śaiva — all indeed is established.
chunks.sanskrit: [and]-yāvattu śivatā nāsya tāvatsvātmānusāriṇīm / tāvatīmeva tāmeṣa prasiddhiṃ nābhiśaṅkate anyasyāmabhiśaṅkī syādbhūyastāṃ bahu manyate / evaṃ bhāviśivatvo@mūṃ prasiddhiṃ manyate dhruvam eka evāgamaścāyaṃ vibhunā sarvadarśinā / darśito yaḥ pravṛtte ca nivṛtte ca pathi sthitaḥ dharmārthakāmamokṣeṣu pūrṇāpūrṇādibhedataḥ / vicitreṣu phaleṣveka upāyaḥ śāmbhavāgamaḥ tasminviṣayavaiviktyādvicitraphaladāyini / citropāyopadeśo@pi na virodhāvaho bhavet laukikaṃ vaidikaṃ sāṅkhyaṃ yogādi pāñcarātrakam / bauddhārhatanyāyaśāstraṃ padārthakramatantraṇam siddhāntatantraśāktādi sarvaṃ brahmodbhavaṃ yataḥ / śrīsvacchandādiṣu proktaṃ sadyojātādibhedataḥ yathaikatrāpi vedādau tattadāśramagāminaḥ / saṃskārāntaramatrāpi tathā liṅgoddhṛtādikam yathāca tatra pūrvasminnāśrame nottarāśramāt / phalameti tathā pāñcarātrādau na śivātmatām eka evāgamastasmāttatra laukikaśāstrataḥ / prabhṛtyāvaiṣṇavādbauddhācchaivātsarvaṃ hi niṣṭhitam

chunks.l2:
[tal-a35-v31] Of it, whatever is the attainable highest state, that is called Trika; through non-severance of all-differences, that very kula is called.

[tal-a35-v32] As high-low-marked, in divided body-parts, one living being should be; so Trika, in all, by the scriptures.

[tal-a35-v33] In the venerable Kālī-kula, and it is said, devoid of five streams, of ten-and-eighteen-difference, this essence is declared.

[tal-a35-v34] In the flower is the fragrance; in the sesame is the oil; in the body is the soul; in the water is the nectar; as, so indeed, of scriptures kula within is established.

[tal-a35-v35] That one alone āgama — this, varied, in varied authority-holders; so indeed she, prasiddhi — for, goes in own-flock and other-flock.

[tal-a35-v36] Sāṅkhya, Yoga, Pāñcarātra, Vedas — and indeed, not should one censure; because all are Śiva-born: thus in the Svacchanda teaching.

[tal-a35-v37] From one āgama — and these, in pieces plucked out, in the world should be āgamas; and by them the people wander, deluded.

[tal-a35-v38] In many-āgama sides too, subject-difference is speakable, necessarily held in high-low-ness, for establishing validity.

[tal-a35-v39] Otherwise not at all anyone's validity is established, surely; permanence-and-noncontradiction, thus, for us are no proof-cause.

[tal-a35-v40] In this part too — of that very one, validity would be — from that utterance; otherwise in non-realization, in fixed non-being, in preference.
chunks.sanskrit: [and]-tasya yattat paraṃ prāpyaṃ dhāma tat trikaśabditam / sarvāvibhedānucchedāt tadeva kulamucyate yathordhvādharatābhāksu dehāṅgeṣu vibhediṣu / ekaṃ prāṇitamevaṃ syāt trikaṃ sarveṣu śāstrataḥ śrīmatkālīkule coktaṃ pañcasrotovivarjitam / daśāṣṭādaśabhedasya sārametatprakīrtitam puṣpe gandhastile tailaṃ dehe jīvo jale@mṛtam / yathā tathaiva śāstrāṇāṃ kulamantaḥ pratiṣṭhitam tadeka evāgamo@yaṃ citraścitre@dhikāriṇi / tathaiva sā prasiddhirhi svayūthyaparayūthyagā sāṃkhyaṃ yogaṃ pāñcarātraṃ vedāṃścaiva na nindayet / yataḥ śivodbhavāḥ sarva iti svacchandaśāsane ekasmādāgamāccaite khaṇḍakhaṇḍā vyapoddhṛtāḥ / loke syurāgamāstaiśca jano bhrāmyati mohitaḥ anekāgamapakṣe@pi vācyā viṣayabheditā / avaśyamūrdhvādharatāsthityā prāmāṇyasiddhaye anyathā naiva kasyāpi prāmāṇyaṃ siddhyati dhruvam / nityatvamavisaṃvāda iti no mānakāraṇam asminnaṃśe@pyamuṣyaiva prāmāṇyaṃ syāttathoditeḥ / anyathāvyākṛtau kḷptāvasatyatve prarocane

chunks.l2:
[tal-a35-v41] Over-implication — of all āgama too the defeater; 'must-reach' — in this proof of the āgama-name.

[tal-a35-v42] 'Must-reach' indeed — this is the account of scriptural endeavor; in the principal limb effort made is really fruit-bearing, because.

[tal-a35-v43] Hence herein anyone striving should be Śambhu-impelled; and there, there, in scriptures, was set forth by the Great Lord.

[tal-a35-v44] At this much — the qualified, who, he is hard to find, thus clearly; so, by venerable Śambhunātha — to me — was told the scripture-union.
